title: Nashik, Maharashtra — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Nashik, Maharashtra: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Nashik is a city in Maharashtra with a population of 1,600,000. A historic city on the Godavari River, known as the wine capital of India and a major Hindu pilgrimage site. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
